verdict.rationale: Docs claim strong layout-aware, agentic parsing of complex PDFs (multi-column, tables, charts, forms) into clean markdown/JSON, and one hands-on user reports it outperformed open-source parsers on complex layouts. However, other hands-on reports contradict this: one user found table output not actually tabular (numbers only accessible via QA, not structured extraction), and another ran a reproducible benchmark showing a plain PyPDF pipeline outperformed LlamaParse's own reported faithfulness score. Missing for 10: independent reproducible benchmarks confirming correct reading order/table structure across diverse real-world documents, and resolution of the contradicting community reports.
